techStack: Package manager: pnpm (requirements.md specifies 'pnpm test'; agent detected vitest/tsx scripts)
Test framework: Vitest v4 with supertest for HTTP integration tests
TypeScript: ESM ('type': 'module'), verbatimModuleSyntax=true — type-only imports must use 'import type'
Module resolution: bundler mode, no file extensions in relative imports
Strict TS: noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters — no dead code allowed
Named exports only; no default exports in existing codebase
features: queryParser.ts parsed fields: search, category, inStock, sort, page, limit — 'featured' not parsed (TODO comment at line 23)
productService.ts filter branches: search, category, inStock — 'featured' branch absent (TODO comment at line 23)
productService.ts sort branches: price_asc, price_desc, name_asc, name_desc — 'rating_desc' branch absent (TODO comment)
data/products.ts: 15 products, none have 'featured' field set — all need backfill (true for ids 1, 8, 11, 14; omit or false for rest)
types/product.ts: already correct — Product has 'featured?: boolean', ProductQuery has 'featured?: boolean', SortOption includes 'rating_desc' — DO NOT MODIFY
architecture: Layering: Route (productRoutes.ts) → Controller (productController.ts) → Service (productService.ts) → Data (dataFetcher.ts + data/products.ts)
queryParser.ts is a controller-level utility: called from productController.ts, result passed directly to getAllProducts
ProductQuery already has 'featured?: boolean' — no type changes needed
New featured filter belongs in productService.ts alongside search/category/inStock blocks (after existing filter chain)
New rating_desc sort belongs in productService.ts switch/if block alongside existing sort branches
Existing sort branches operate on a spread copy ([...result].sort(...)) — rating_desc must follow the same pattern to avoid mutating source array
edgeCases: featured=true → exactly 4 products returned, all with featured === true (ids 1, 8, 11, 14)
featured=false → exactly 11 products returned, all with falsy featured (omitted or false); filter uses '(p.featured ?? false) === false'
featured=true&category=electronics → exactly 1 product (id 1, Laptop); featured filter and category filter must compose
featured param absent → no filter applied; all 15 products pass through (query.featured is undefined)
featured param invalid (e.g. 'yes', '1', 'maybe') → query.featured not set; only exact strings 'true'/'false' accepted
sort=rating_desc applied after filters, on a derived copy — must not mutate source products array
Products without 'featured' field must be treated as false via nullish coalescing (?? false) in filter expression
Pre-existing suites must not regress: 'GET /products' (11 tests), 'Pagination' (3 tests), 'Auth middleware' (4 tests)
